def kernel_invoke(self,address,args=(),stack=None):
        require(self.kernel_active,'Original kernel inventory absent')
        self.returned=False;self.idle_endpoint=False
        if stack is None:stack=self.word(0xf09090)
        for reg,value in zip(REGS,args):self.uc.reg_write(reg,value)
        self.uc.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_SP,stack);self.uc.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_LR,RETURN|1)
        self.uc.emu_start(address,RETURN+2,count=3000000,timeout=15000000)
        require(self.returned or self.idle_endpoint,'Kernel call did not reach original return or declared idle sentinel')
        result=self.uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
        row=dict(entry=hex(address),arguments=[hex(n)for n in args],original_return_endpoint_reached=self.returned,
            idle_sentinel_reached=self.idle_endpoint,current_after=hex(self.word(0xf09090)),result=hex(result))
        self.kernel_calls.append(row)
        return result

def register_stock_GIR(self):
        platform=self.invoke(0x25dc81,())
        require(platform==struct.unpack_from('<I',self.resource_bytes,12)[0],'Original resource platform check differs')
        self.uc.mem_write(INPUT,b'\xcc'*128)
        accepted=self.invoke(0x41cc47,(GIR,INPUT))
        require(accepted==1,'Original GIR registration rejected')
        catalog=self.invoke(0x41b15b,());begin,end,capacity=struct.unpack('<3I',self.uc.mem_read(catalog,12))
        require(end-begin==24 and capacity>=end,'Original GIR catalog not one record')
        kind=self.uc.mem_read(INPUT,1)[0];record=bytes(self.uc.mem_read(begin,24))
        require(record[0]==kind and record[1]==1 and self.word(begin+12)==GIR and
            self.word(begin+16)==self.resource_directory_bytes,'Original GIR catalog source fields differ')
        return dict(original_entry='0x41cc46',accepted=accepted,platform_hash=hex(platform),
            catalog=hex(catalog),kind=kind,record=hex(begin),record_words=[hex(x)for x in struct.unpack('<6I',record)],
            mapped_stock_bytes_sha256=hashlib.sha256(self.resource_bytes).hexdigest(),
            original_boot_resource_registration_location_verified=False,host_seeded_catalog=False,
            appended_stock_GIR_placement_is_explicit_fixture=True)

def set_cell(self,id,icon,size):
        before=len(self.sql_events)
        self.invoke(0x316277,(self.menu_pointer(),icon,id,size))
        require(all(r['closed'] for r in self.statements.values()),'Setter left native statement open')
        return self.sql_events[before:]

def __init__(self,stock,build):
        self.build=build
        self.raw_allocations={};self.next_raw=0x08400020
        self.audio=[];self.events=[];self.entry_events=[];self.install_callers=[]
        super().__init__(stock,[{'name':'Chinese_Big5_MeiLing.vpm',
            'data':(ROOT/build['package']).read_bytes()}],selected_voice='mei-lingb')
        self.menu_hooks={0x3954cc:'raw_allocate',0x3954e4:'raw_allocate',
            0x3954d8:'raw_allocate',0x39544c:'raw_allocate',
            0x386f04:'raw_free',0x386f14:'raw_free',0x3954f0:'raw_free',
            0x525f14:'audio_register_boundary',0x36b720:'audio_start_boundary'}
        self.hooks.update(self.menu_hooks)
        self.initial_regions={}
        self.declared_platform_fixture_changes=[]
        for region in self.stock.copies:
            if region['runtime_start']==0xf00000:continue
            actual=bytes(self.uc.mem_read(region['runtime_start'],region['size']))
            original=self.stock.read(region['load_start'],region['size'])
            if actual!=original:
                differences=[n for n,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(actual,original)) if a!=b]
                require(region['runtime_start']==0x05400000 and differences==[0] and actual[0]==1,
                        'Unknown initialized fixture modification: '+hex(region['runtime_start']))
                self.declared_platform_fixture_changes.append({'address':'0x05400000',
                    'before':hex(original[0]),'fixture':1,'purpose':'Inherited platform active-byte fixture'})
            self.initial_regions[region['runtime_start']]=actual
        require(build['combined_file_bytes']<0x300000,'Readback would overlap the new raw heap')
        require(self.word(0xf11e04+8)==0,'Unexpected stock registry seed')

def verify_memory(self,voice,exports,dbsha):
        require(not self.invalid_accesses and not self.native_fatal_entries and not self.audio,'Runtime fault or unexpected audio request')
        oldram=struct.unpack_from('<I',(ROOT/self.build['original_binary']).read_bytes(),4)[0]
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(IMAGE+12,oldram-12))==voice and bytes(self.uc.mem_read(STUBS,480))==exports,
            'Whole original voice RAM or40 exports changed')
        tables={}
        for table,names in [('app_component_api',self.build['private_api']),('player_component_api',self.build['player_api'])]:
            values=list(struct.unpack('<'+str(len(names))+'I',self.uc.mem_read(self.symbol(table),4*len(names))))
            require(values==[self.symbol(n)for n in names],'Whole compiled private/player API table changed')
            tables[table]=[hex(v)for v in values]
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(self.build['extension_base'],0x10000))==self.extension_code,'Whole RX extension code changed')
        for address,raw in self.initial_regions.items():
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(address,len(raw)))==raw,'Whole original initialized code/GUI region changed '+hex(address))
        for address,raw in self.code_images:
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(address,len(raw)))==raw,'Whole original code image changed '+hex(address))
        require(not self.conditional_region_writes,'Kernel singleton bootstrap unexpectedly mutated declared GUI initialized region')
        for ptr,entry in self.raw_allocations.items():self.verify_guard(ptr,entry)
        for entry in self.handles.values():
            p,n=entry['pointer'],entry['length']
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(p-32,32))==b'\xa5'*32 and bytes(self.uc.mem_read(p+n,32))==b'\xa5'*32,
                'Whole opaque allocation canary changed')
        self.verify_storage_guards();self.verify_descriptor_guards();self.verify_closed_files()
        for bottom in [CONTROLLER_STACK,IDLE_STACK]:
            require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(bottom,64))==b'\xa5'*64,'Synthetic stack leading64 canary changed')
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(0x2d226f4,24))==b'\xa5'*24,'Native timer stack leading24 canary changed')
        for row in self.GUI_stack_canaries:
            require(row.get('whole16384_native_fill_verified') and
                bytes(self.uc.mem_read(int(row['bottom'],16),64)).hex()==row['leading64_after_native_fill_hex'],
                'Original GUI stack crossed its observed leading64 boundary')
        require(len(self.GUI_stack_canaries)==2,'Missing both original GUI stack boundary snapshots')
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(CODE,8))==struct.pack('<2I',0xeafffffe,0xe12fff1e),'Declared synthetic code sentinels changed')
        require(sha(DATABASE)==dbsha and not self.statements and
            list(self.db.execute('SELECT id,icon,size FROM custom_table ORDER BY id'))==self.database_before,
            'Readonly backup or in-memory baseline DB changed')
        return dict(original_voice_RAM_and40_exports_unchanged=True,private12_and_player2_API_tables=tables,
            whole_initialized_regions_checked=[dict(address=hex(a),bytes=len(raw))for a,raw in self.initial_regions.items()],
            whole_original_code_images_checked=[dict(address=hex(a),bytes=len(raw))for a,raw in self.code_images],
            whole_RX_extension_code_unchanged=True,all_allocation_storage_descriptor_and_stack_boundaries_intact=True,
            original_GUI_stack_canary_inputs=self.GUI_stack_canaries,backup_and_inmemory_DB_unchanged=True,
            native_closed_file_inventory_verified=True,guest_memory_or_counters_rewritten_by_guard=False,
            outer=self.summarize(),outer_region_module_tasks_and_mutex_tokens_remain_resident=True,
            outer_cleanup_task_quiescence_or_safe_unload_verified=False)

def finish_constructor(self):
        base=0x5400000;before=self.initial_regions[base];expected=bytearray(before)
        require(self.conditional_region_writes==WRITERS,'Unexpected original general-menu initialized-data writer inventory')
        for row in WRITERS:
            p=int(row['address'],16);value=int(row['value'],16)
            expected[p-base:p-base+4]=struct.pack('<I',value)
        require(bytes(self.uc.mem_read(base,len(before)))==bytes(expected),
            'Whole general-menu conditional initialized data differs beyond exact original writers')
        self.initial_regions[base]=bytes(expected)
        try:snapshot=SelectionPlayerVM.finish(self)
        finally:self.initial_regions[base]=before
        snapshot.update(full_general_menu_conditional_region_matches_exact_native_writers=True,
            original_native_writer_events=WRITERS,host_rewrote_GUI_initialized_bytes=False)
        return snapshot

def observe(self,uc,address,size,data):
        caller=uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)&~1
        if self.active_condition is not None:
            row=self.active_condition
            if row.get('original_return_branch_reached') and address==int(row['native_caller'],16):
                row['native_constructor_returned']=True
                self.condition_constructor_runs.append(row);self.active_condition=None
        if address==0x3008a0:
            pointer=uc.reg_read(REGS[0]);storage=self.declared_storage(pointer,24)
            allowed=caller in [0x3103e6,0x46c286,0x358c82,0x358c8a,0x3ec562,0x3ec56a]or(
                caller==RETURN and self.allow_direct_backend_control)
            if allowed and storage:
                require(self.active_backend is None and len(self.backend_initializations)<8192,'Nested or exhausted native backend scope')
                row=dict(original_entry='0x3008a0',pointer=hex(pointer),native_caller=hex(caller),bytes=24,
                    storage_boundary=storage,before_hex=bytes(uc.mem_read(pointer,24)).hex(),native_zero_writes=[],
                    original_body_executed=False,host_seeded_backend_bytes=False)
                self.backend_initializations.append(row);self.active_backend=row;self.visits[address]+=1
                # Skip only inherited OuterVM's noop at3008A0. Leave all
                # registers, PC/SP/LR intact, executing the native MOV/STRe6.
                return
        if address==0x3008ae and self.active_backend is not None:
            row=self.active_backend;require(len(row['native_zero_writes'])==6 and
                bytes(uc.mem_read(int(row['pointer'],16),24))==b'\0'*24,'Native backend six zero stores incomplete')
            row.update(original_body_executed=True,after_hex=bytes(uc.mem_read(int(row['pointer'],16),24)).hex())
            self.active_backend=None
        if address==0x3ec540:
            pointer=uc.reg_read(REGS[0]);storage=self.declared_storage(pointer,52)
            if storage:
                require(self.active_condition is None,'Unsupported reentrant native condition constructor')
                self.active_condition=dict(original_entry='0x3ec540',pointer=hex(pointer),native_caller=hex(caller),
                    storage_boundary=storage,bootstrap_token_retained=False,native_constructor_returned=False)
        if address==0x3009a0 and caller==0x3ec572 and self.active_condition is not None:
            pointer=uc.reg_read(REGS[0]);row=self.active_condition
            require(pointer==int(row['pointer'],16)and pointer not in self.dispatcher_condition_tokens and
                self.word(pointer+24)==self.native_condition_magic and bytes(uc.mem_read(pointer,24))==b'\0'*24 and
                bytes(uc.mem_read(pointer+28,24))==b'\0'*24 and self.mutexes[pointer]==0,
                'Original condition storage/init or retained bootstrap token differs')
            row['bootstrap_token_retained']=True
            token=dict(pointer=hex(pointer),native_caller='0x3ec572',explicit_retained_bootstrap_token=1,
                ordinary_mutex_counter_not_incremented_or_swept=True,real_kernel_owner_wait_and_safe_lifetime_verified=False)
            self.dispatcher_condition_tokens[pointer]=token
            self.visits[address]+=1;self.ret(0);return
        if address==0x3ec57e and self.active_condition is not None:
            row=self.active_condition;require(row['bootstrap_token_retained'],'Native condition returned without declared token')
            row.update(original_IRQ_restore_call_reached=True,original_owner_transfer_300AE4_body_executed=True,
                real_thread_owner_or_condition_wait_verified=False)
        if address==0x3ec582 and self.active_condition is not None:
            self.active_condition['original_IRQ_restore_call_completed']=True
        if address==0x3ec586 and self.active_condition is not None:
            row=self.active_condition
            require(row.get('original_IRQ_restore_call_completed')and
                uc.reg_read(REGS[3])==(int(row['native_caller'],16)|1),
                'Original condition IRQ restore or LR-return epilogue incomplete')
            row['original_return_branch_reached']=True
        return super().observe(uc,address,size,data)

def observe(self, uc, address, size, data):
        caller = uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)&~1
        if address == 0x358bf8:
            self.record_descriptor(uc,caller)
        if not self.kernel_active:
            return super().observe(uc,address,size,data)
        if self.running_task is None:
            self.running_task = self.word(0xf09090)
        if self.pending_restore is not None and address == (int(self.pending_restore['saved_PC'],16)&~1):
            row = self.pending_restore
            row['original_task_resume_destination_reached'] = True
            self.running_task = int(row['current'],16)
            self.dispatch_destinations.append(dict(address=hex(address),task=hex(self.running_task)))
            self.pending_restore = None
        task = self.running_task
        require(task in self.native_TCBs,'Running CPU task lacks observed original TCB construction')
        if address == CODE:
            require(task == self.idle and self.word(0xf09090) == self.idle,'Idle sentinel task mismatch')
            self.idle_endpoint = True
            uc.emu_stop()
            return
        if address == POST:
            target = uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            require(target in self.native_TCBs,'Original post target lacks native TCB construction')
            self.kernel_events.append(dict(entry=hex(address),running_task=hex(task),
                ready_head=hex(self.word(0xf09090)),arguments=[hex(uc.reg_read(r))for r in REGS],
                original_post_entry_reached=True,host_fabricated_wake=False))
            self.visits[address] += 1
            return
        if address == RESTORE:
            target = self.word(0xf09090)
            require(target in self.native_TCBs,'Restore target lacks observed native TCB construction')
            frame = self.word(target+12)
            row = dict(current=hex(target),previous_running_task=hex(task),saved_context=hex(frame),
                saved_PC=hex(self.word(frame+4)),context_format=bytes(uc.mem_read(target+23,1))[0],
                original_restore_entry_reached=True,original_task_resume_destination_reached=False,
                python_CPU_context_restore=False)
            self.kernel_restores.append(row)
            self.pending_restore = row
            for wait in self.task_waits[task]:
                wait['context_restore_boundary_reached'] = True
            self.visits[address] += 1
            return

        # Native function return addresses are checked in the task that entered
        # the function, including when another task changed F09090 meanwhile.
        for pending, collection, pointer_key in [
                (self.task_releases[task],self.native_full_releases,'pointer'),
                (self.task_lower_waits[task],self.native_lower_wait_operations,'condition')]:
            if pending and address == int(pending[-1]['native_caller'],16):
                row = pending.pop()
                ptr = int(row[pointer_key],16)
                owner,depth = self.sync_counter_from_native(ptr)
                row.update(original_body_returned=True,original_return=uc.reg_read(REGS[0]),
                    native_owner_after=hex(owner),native_recursion_after=depth,
                    ready_head_after=hex(self.word(0xf09090)),running_task_after=hex(task),
                    guest_fields_written_by_original_only=True)
        waits = self.task_waits[task]
        if waits and waits[-1].get('original_return_branch_reached') and address == int(waits[-1]['native_caller'],16):
            row = waits.pop()
            ptr = int(row['mutex'],16)
            owner,depth = self.sync_counter_from_native(ptr)
            require(owner == task and self.mutexes[ptr] == 1,'Native condition returned without actual-task mutex reacquisition')
            row.update(original_wait_returned=True,original_return=uc.reg_read(REGS[0]),
                native_owner_after=hex(owner),native_reacquisition_verified=True,
                real_kernel_wait_verified=True,physical_kernel_or_IRQ_timing_verified=False)

        self.active_condition = self.task_constructors.get(task)
        if address == 0x3ec5c6:
            cond,mutex,deadline,kind = [uc.reg_read(r) for r in REGS]
            require(cond in self.native_semaphores and mutex in self.native_semaphores,
                'Condition wait uses unobserved native semaphore')
            row = dict(original_entry=hex(address),native_caller=hex(caller),condition=hex(cond),
                mutex=hex(mutex),native_argument=hex(deadline),native_kind=kind,running_task=hex(task),
                semaphore_owner_before=hex(self.word(mutex+8)),native_owner_gate_passed=False,
                original_wait_returned=False,real_kernel_wait_verified=False)
            self.native_condition_waits.append(row)
            waits.append(row)
        if address == 0x3ec5ea and waits:
            row = waits[-1]
            require(self.word(int(row['mutex'],16)+8) == task == uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_R4),
                'Original condition owner gate running task mismatch')
            row['native_owner_gate_passed'] = True
        if address == 0x3ec6a0 and waits:
            require(uc.reg_read(REGS[3]) == (int(waits[-1]['native_caller'],16)|1),
                'Condition return epilogue did not restore saved LR')
            waits[-1]['original_return_branch_reached'] = True
        if address == 0x3ec498:
            row=dict(original_entry=hex(address),native_caller=hex(caller),
                condition=hex(uc.reg_read(REGS[0])),running_task=hex(task),host_fabricated_notification=False,
                original_broadcast_returned=False)
            self.condition_notifications.append(row)
            self.task_notifications[task].append(row)
        if address == 0x3ec4f8 and self.task_notifications[task]:
            row=self.task_notifications[task][-1]
            require(uc.reg_read(REGS[3])==(int(row['native_caller'],16)|1),'Broadcast native saved LR differs')
            row['original_return_branch_reached']=True
        if self.task_notifications[task] and self.task_notifications[task][-1].get('original_return_branch_reached') and address==int(self.task_notifications[task][-1]['native_caller'],16):
            self.task_notifications[task].pop()['original_broadcast_returned']=True

        if address in [0x3009a0,0x3008b0]:
            ptr = uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            cpp = caller == (0x310408 if address == 0x3009a0 else 0x310414)
            recursive_cpp = caller == (0x46c2ae if address == 0x3009a0 else 0x46c2be)
            ctor = address == 0x3009a0 and caller == 0x3ec572 and self.active_condition is not None
            aux_wait = address == 0x3009a0 and caller == 0x3ec61c and waits and ptr == int(waits[-1]['condition'],16)+28
            reacquire = address == 0x3009a0 and caller == 0x3ec692 and waits and ptr == int(waits[-1]['mutex'],16)
            notify_aux = caller == (0x3ec4be if address == 0x3009a0 else 0x3ec4ee)
            require(cpp or recursive_cpp or ctor or aux_wait or reacquire or notify_aux,
                'Native mutex caller outside explicit per-task GUI scope: '+hex(caller))
            require(self.declared_storage(ptr,24),'Native semaphore outside declared guarded storage')
            if cpp:
                require(self.word(ptr-4)==0xc1b5dc and self.word(ptr+16)==0x31041c,'Native C++ mutex vtable/tag mismatch')
            if recursive_cpp:
                require(self.word(ptr-28)==0xc1b5c4 and self.word(ptr+16)==0x46c2c8,'Native recursive C++ mutex vtable/tag mismatch')
            if notify_aux:
                require(self.task_notifications[task] and ptr==int(self.task_notifications[task][-1]['condition'],16)+28,
                    'Broadcast auxiliary mutex does not belong to active native condition')
            if ctor:
                require(ptr == int(self.active_condition['pointer'],16) and
                    self.word(ptr+24)==self.native_condition_magic and bytes(uc.mem_read(ptr,24))==b'\0'*24 and
                    bytes(uc.mem_read(ptr+28,24))==b'\0'*24 and ptr not in self.dispatcher_condition_tokens,
                    'Original condition constructor token storage differs')
            if ptr not in self.native_semaphores:
                self.register_native_semaphore(ptr)
            if ctor:
                self.native_semaphores[ptr]['retained_condition_token'] = True
            scope = ('Cpp_mutex' if cpp else 'recursive_Cpp_mutex') if (cpp or recursive_cpp) else ('condition_constructor' if ctor else
                ('condition_reacquisition' if reacquire else 'condition_auxiliary'))
            row = dict(original_entry=hex(address),pointer=hex(ptr),native_caller=hex(caller),
                operation='lock' if address==0x3009a0 else 'unlock',scope=scope,running_task=hex(task),
                entry_SP=hex(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)),entry_LR=hex(uc.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_LR)),
                before_words=[hex(self.word(ptr+4*n))for n in range(6)],native_body_returned=False,
                semaphore_fields_written_by_original_only=True,host_CPU_context_restore=False)
            self.native_mutex_runs.append(row)
            self.task_mutex_ops[task].append(row)
            if reacquire:
                waits[-1]['original_reacquire_entry_reached'] = True
            self.visits[address] += 1
            return
        if address in [0x300a0a,0x30092a]:
            pending = self.task_mutex_ops[task]
            require(pending,'Mutex epilogue has no pending operation for actual running task')
            row = pending.pop()
            require(address == (0x300a0a if row['operation']=='lock' else 0x30092a) and
                uc.reg_read(REGS[3])==(int(row['native_caller'],16)|1),'Native mutex task/caller epilogue mismatch')
            ptr = int(row['pointer'],16)
            owner,depth = self.sync_counter_from_native(ptr)
            native_result=uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            if row['operation']=='lock' and native_result==0:
                require(owner==task,'Native lock returned0 without ownership by originating task')
            if row['scope'] == 'condition_constructor':
                require(owner==task and depth==0 and self.active_condition is not None,'Retained condition token native owner mismatch')
                self.active_condition.update(bootstrap_token_retained=True,
                    original_mutex_lock_and_owner_store_executed=True,native_owner=hex(owner))
                self.dispatcher_condition_tokens[ptr]=dict(pointer=hex(ptr),native_caller='0x3ec572',
                    explicit_retained_bootstrap_token=1,original_native_owner_store=True,native_owner=hex(owner),
                    ordinary_mutex_counter_not_incremented_or_swept=True,safe_lifetime_verified=False)
            row.update(native_body_returned=True,original_return_branch_reached=True,
                after_words=[hex(self.word(ptr+4*n))for n in range(6)],native_owner=hex(owner),
                original_return=native_result,native_lock_acquired_by_originating_task=(owner==task if row['operation']=='lock' else None),
                native_recursion_count=depth,thread_owned_list_head=hex(self.word(task+32)),
                ready_head_at_epilogue=hex(self.word(0xf09090)))
        if address == 0x300bb8:
            ptr = uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            require(ptr in self.native_semaphores and self.word(ptr+8)==task,
                'Original full release lacks current native ownership')
            require(caller in [0x3ec642,0x3ec648,0x30090a],
                'Original full release caller outside observed GUI scope: '+hex(caller))
            row = dict(original_entry=hex(address),pointer=hex(ptr),native_caller=hex(caller),
                running_task=hex(task),native_owner_before=hex(self.word(ptr+8)),
                native_waiter_head_before=hex(self.word(ptr+12)),original_body_returned=False,
                host_wrote_owner_or_links=False)
            self.native_full_releases.append(row)
            self.task_releases[task].append(row)
        if address == 0x300a14:
            ptr = uc.reg_read(REGS[0])
            require(waits and caller in [0x3ec664,0x3ec674] and ptr==int(waits[-1]['condition'],16),
